title: FATHER GOD, LET NO EVIL COME NEAR ME TODAY | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: I stand in the authority of the name that is above every other name, the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. And I decree and declare that no evil shall come near me this day. I take my position in the heavenly places, far above principalities and powers, far above rulers of darkness and spiritual wickedness in high places. And I declare that I am seated with Christ in victory and dominion.

I enforce the victory of Calvary over every demonic agenda, every satanic conspiracy, every evil manipulation that seeks to manifest in my life today and I command them to bow to the supremacy of the name of Jesus. I decree that every arrow fashioned against my life, every weapon formed against my destiny, every plot of the enemy, every scheme of darkness is nullified right now by the blood of Jesus. I declare that no evil report shall prosper against me. No negative word shall take root in my life.

No demonic agenda shall manifest in my affairs this day. No witchcraft manipulation shall succeed against my household. No ancestral covenant shall have a voice in my generation. No marine spell shall penetrate my habitation. I cover myself, my household, my children, my spouse, my parents, my siblings, my finances, my health, my business, my career, my ministry, my calling, my destiny.

With the precious blood of the lamb that speaks better things than the blood of Abel, I activate the hedge of divine protection around my life. And I command every gate of my life to be shut against the enemy. I decree that the angels of the Lord are encamped around me. They go before me to make the crooked places straight. They stand behind me to cover my blind spots. They are at my right hand and at my left hand to defend me from every attack and no evil can penetrate the wall of fire that surrounds me.

I declare that I dwell in the secret place of the most high and I abide under the shadow of the almighty. Therefore, no plague shall come near my dwelling. No evil shall befall me. No arrow shall fly by day against me. No terror shall come by night to torment me. No pestilence shall walk in darkness around me. No destruction shall waste at noonday in my environment.

I speak to every power of witchcraft, every coven of darkness, every satanic altar, every demonic shrine, every marine covenant, every water spirit agenda, every ancestral curse, every generational bondage, every familiar spirit, every monitoring spirit, every spirit husband, every spirit wife that seeks to manifest in my life this day. And I command them to expire right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that I am redeemed from the curse of the law. I am delivered from the power of darkness.

I am translated into the kingdom of God's dear son. I am justified by faith. I am sanctified by the blood. I am sealed by the Holy Spirit. And no weapon of the enemy can prosper against me because greater is he that is in me than he that is in the world. I declare that divine favor goes before me today. That supernatural opportunities locate me.

that divine connections align with me, that heavenly appointments keep me, that uncommon grace distinguishes me, that the blessing of the Lord makes me rich and adds no sorrow to it. I decree that I walk in divine health, divine strength, divine wisdom, divine understanding, divine knowledge, divine revelation, and the spirit of the Lord rests upon me mightily.

I command every spirit of fear, every spirit of anxiety, every spirit of worry, every spirit of confusion, every spirit of delay, every spirit of stagnation, every spirit of backwardness, every spirit of limitation to release me now in Jesus' name and to go back to the pit of hell where they belong. I prophesy to this day and I declare that it is pregnant with divine possibilities, saturated with the glory of God, overshadowed by the presence of the most high, orchestrated by the wisdom of heaven.

And I shall not be a victim but a victor. I shall not be beneath but above only. I shall not be the tail but the head. I shall not borrow but lend to many nations. I shall not be confused, but I shall have clarity. I shall not be defeated, but I shall triumph in Christ Jesus. I decree that my steps are ordered by the Lord, that divine guidance directs my path, that angelic assistance accompanies my journey, that I shall not make mistakes that will cost me my destiny. I shall not fall into traps set by the enemy.

I shall not be a casualty of warfare, but I shall be a testimony of God's faithfulness. I shall not be a victim of circumstances, but I shall be a champion of faith. I release the fire of the Holy Ghost to consume every evil imagination, every evil thought, every evil dream, every evil vision, every evil projection, every evil pronouncement, every evil prophecy that the enemy has released concerning my life. I decree that as I step out today, I step out under an open heaven. I step out with the backing of heaven.

I step out with the mandate of the Almighty. I step out with the covering of the blood. I step out with the companionship of angels. I step out with the seal of the spirit. And no devil in hell or demon on assignment can stop what God has ordained for me. I declare that this is my season of uncommon favor, unusual grace, unprecedented breakthrough, accelerated promotion, supernatural elevation, divine restoration. And I receive it now by faith in Jesus's mighty name.

I take authority over every evil voice speaking against my life. And I command them to be silenced forever in the name of Jesus. I decree that every satanic verdict pronounced against me is overturned by the blood of Jesus. Every demonic judgment issued against my family is reversed by the authority of the word. Every evil sentence passed against my destiny is canceled by the power of the cross.

I declare that I am untouchable to the enemy, unreachable by darkness, inaccessible to evil forces, and impenetrable to demonic attacks because I am hidden in Christ and my life is hid with Christ in God. I speak to my spirit man and I command it to be alert, to be sensitive, to be discerning, to be watchful against every subtle attack of the enemy. I decree that I shall not be ignorant of the devices of Satan. I shall not be deceived by the cunning of the serpent.

I shall not be manipulated by the wisdom of this world. I shall not be seduced by the lust of the flesh. I shall not be entangled by the pride of life. I declare that the anointing of God upon my life breaks every yoke, destroys every burden, removes every limitation, shatters every chain, and liberates me from every form of bondage. I command every evil gathering, every demonic council, every satanic meeting, every witchcraft assembly that is summoned against my life to scatter right now by the thunder of God.

I decree that confusion enters into their camps, that their plans backfire against them, that their weapons turn against them, that their arrows return to their own hearts, that their evil boomerangs upon their own heads. I declare that no weapon formed against me shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I shall condemn because this is my heritage as a servant of the Lord, and my righteousness is from the most high God.

I release the sword of the spirit to cut off every evil hand stretched against my life. To seiver every cord of wickedness attached to my destiny, to break every chain of darkness bound to my progress, to destroy every rope of evil tied to my breakthrough. I decree that every evil covenant speaking against me is terminated by the blood of Jesus. Every demonic agreement working against me is nullified by the cross of Christ. Every satanic contract signed against me is torn apart by the power of the resurrection.

I declare that my mind is protected by the helmet of salvation. My heart is guarded by the breastplate of righteousness. My feet are shored with the preparation of the gospel of peace. My faith is the shield that quenches every fiery doubt of the wicked one. And the sword of the spirit, which is the word of God, is my offensive weapon against every attack of darkness. I decree that I am fully armored, completely protected, totally covered, and absolutely secured in Christ Jesus.

I speak to every territory I will enter today. And I command every evil presence to vacate, every demonic stronghold to crumble, every satanic altar to be consumed by fire, every witchcraft shrine to be demolished by the power of God. I declare that wherever I go today becomes holy ground. Wherever I step becomes consecrated territory. Wherever I stand becomes a place of worship. Wherever I sit becomes a throne of grace. I decree that the presence of God goes before me to prepare the way.

The glory of God surrounds me to protect my path. The power of God walks through me to accomplish his will. I take authority over the atmosphere around me and I command every evil spirit loitering in the air to be bound and cast into the abyss. I decree that the heavens above me are opened. The windows of heaven are unlocked. The gates of brass are broken. The bars of iron are caught as the blessings of God rain upon my life like a mighty flood. I declare that favor surrounds me like a shield.

Mercy follows me like a shadow. goodness accompanies me like a friend and the loving kindness of the Lord covers me like a garment. I prophesy to every organ in my body and I command them to function in divine health and supernatural strength. I speak to my eyes and I decree that they shall see clearly. They shall perceive spiritually. They shall discern accurately. They shall focus properly. I speak to my ears and I declare that they shall hear the voice of God distinctly.

They shall receive divine instructions clearly. They shall be deaf to the voice of the enemy completely. I speak to my mouth and I command it to speak words of life, to prophesy blessings, to declare victory, to proclaim the goodness of God. I speak to my hands and I decree that they shall prosper in every work. They shall build and not destroy. They shall create and not demolish. They shall establish and not tear down. I speak to my feet and I declare that they shall walk in paths of righteousness.

They shall stand in places of favor. They shall run and not be weary. They shall mount up with wings like eagles. I command every inherited sickness, every generational disease, every ancestral infirmity, every familial weakness to be uprooted from my life by the power of the Holy Ghost. I decree that divine health flows through my veins. Supernatural strength energizes my body. Heavenly vitality fills my being and the life of God saturates every cell, every tissue, every organ in my physical frame.

I declare that by the stripes of Jesus, I am healed. By the wounds of Christ, I am made whole. By the sacrifice of the lamb, I am restored to perfect health. I take authority over my finances. And I command every spirit of poverty, every demon of lack, every force of insufficiency, every power of scarcity to be destroyed in my life right now. I decree that the windows of heaven are opened over my finances. The storehouses of God are unlocked for my benefit. The treasures of darkness are released to me.

The hidden riches of secret places are given to me. I declare that I am a lender and not a borrower. I am blessed in my coming in and blessed in my going out. I am blessed in the city and blessed in the field. I am blessed in my basket and blessed in my store. And everything I set my hand to do shall prosper and succeed. I speak to every closed door in my life. And I command them to be opened by the key of David. I decree that doors of opportunity swing open before me. Gates of favor are lifted for me.

Portals of breakthrough are accessible to me. And no man can shut what God has opened in my life. I declare that divine connections are established for me, strategic relationships are arranged for me, covenant partnerships are assigned to me, and the right people at the right time come into my life for the right purpose. I command every spirit of confusion to depart from my mind right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that I have the mind of Christ. I think the thoughts of God.

I perceive with divine understanding. I reason with heavenly wisdom. I make decisions with supernatural insight. I declare that clarity floods my consciousness, revelation illuminates my understanding, wisdom directs my choices, and the counsel of the Lord stands in my heart. I take authority over my family and I cover them with the blood of Jesus from the crown of their heads to the soles of their feet. I decree that no evil shall befall them. No plague shall come near their dwelling.

No accident shall occur in their path. No sickness shall invade their bodies. No trouble shall overwhelm their souls. I declare that they are protected by the angels of God. They are shielded by the power of the most high. They are covered by the shadow of the almighty and they are kept by the covenant of grace. I speak to my destiny and I command every delay to be broken, every setback to be reversed, every obstruction to be removed, every hindrance to be demolished.

I decree that I am entering into my season of acceleration, my time of multiplication, my moment of manifestation, my hour of visitation. I declare that what God has promised shall surely come to pass. What heaven has decreed shall certainly be fulfilled. What the prophets have spoken shall definitely manifest and nothing shall be impossible for me because all things are possible to him that believes.

I release the fire of God to consume every altar erected against me, every sacrifice offered against me, every incantation pronounced against me, every ritual performed against me, every evil concoction prepared against me. I decree that every witchcraft operation targeting my life is terminated. Every occult manipulation affecting my progress is destroyed. Every demonic ritual influencing my destiny is nullified. And every satanic ceremony impacting my calling is cancelled by the superior blood of Jesus Christ.

I command every evil mark, every demonic seal, every satanic stamp, every witchcraft signature upon my life to be erased by the blood of Jesus. I decree that I am marked by God, sealed by the Holy Spirit, stamped with divine approval and signed by the hand of the Almighty. I declare that I belong to the Lord. I am his peculiar treasure. I am his prized possession. I am his beloved child and no force of darkness can lay claim to my life or my destiny.

I prophesy to my tomorrow and I declare that it is secured in the hands of God, orchestrated by divine providence, arranged by heavenly wisdom and guaranteed by covenant promises. I decree that my future is bright. My destiny is glorious. My inheritance is incorruptible. My reward is eternal. and no power of hell can abort what heaven has conceived concerning my life.

I speak to every seed of greatness planted in my spirit and I command them to germinate, to sprout, to grow, to flourish, to bear fruit 30fold, 60fold, and 100fold in this season. I take authority over the second heaven and I command every satanic surveillance, every demonic monitoring, every evil observation, every witchcraft espionage against my life to be blinded right now by the glory of God.

I decree that the enemy cannot track my movements, cannot predict my actions, cannot anticipate my decisions, cannot forall my breakthroughs because I move by the leading of the spirit and I am guided by the counsel of the most high. I declare that I am hidden in the secret place, concealed in the shadow of the almighty, covered by the wings of the cherobim and protected by the sovereign hand of God.

I speak to every evil deposit, every demonic implantation, every satanic injection, every witchcraft incession in my body, in my soul, in my spirit. And I command them to come out right now and be consumed by the fire of the Holy Ghost. I decree that my body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. My members are instruments of righteousness. My mind is the dwelling place of divine thoughts. My heart is the habitation of God through the spirit.

and no foreign substance, no evil entity, no demonic presence can coexist with the glory that resides within me. I declare that I am cleansed by the blood, purified by the word, sanctified by the spirit, and I am holy unto the Lord. I command every evil pattern, every negative cycle, every vicious circle, every destructive routine that has been established in my life or in my family lineage to be broken right now by the hammer of God's word. I decree that old things have passed away. All things have become new.

Former things shall not be remembered. Ancient cycles are terminated. And I have entered into a new dimension of glory, a fresh season of grace, an unprecedented era of blessing, and an uncommon dispensation of favor. I declare that what happened to my parents shall not happen to me. What afflicted my grandparents shall not afflict my generation. What destroyed my ancestors shall not destroy my lineage. Because I am a new creation in Christ Jesus. And the blood of Jesus has rewritten my family history.

I release the thunder of God to scatter every conspiracy, every collaboration, every confederation, every alliance of darkness that has been formed against my life, my family, my ministry, my calling, my assignment, my mandate. I decree that their unity is broken, their agreement is shattered, their partnership is dissolved, their cooperation is terminated, and they turn against one another in confusion and defeat. I declare that no weapon fashioned in secret shall succeed. No trap set in darkness shall catch me.

No ambush prepared in hidden places shall harm me because the Lord reveals their secrets to me, exposes their plans before me, and delivers me from every snare of the fowler. I take authority over my sleep and I command every evil visitation, every demonic dream, every nightmare, every spiritual attack during sleep to seize in my life forever. I decree that when I lie down, I shall not be afraid. My sleep shall be sweet. My rest shall be peaceful. My night shall be secure.

And the angels of God keep watch over me while I sleep. I declare that I receive divine downloads in my sleep, heavenly revelations in my dreams, prophetic insight in my visions, and strategic wisdom in my subconscious. And every dream of the enemy is converted into a testimony of God's goodness in my life. I speak to every foundation of my life.

And I command every crack to be sealed, every weakness to be strengthened, every compromise to be corrected, every error to be rectified by the master builder, Jesus Christ. I decree that my foundation is built upon the rock, established in righteousness, secured in truth, fortified by grace, and reinforced by the covenant. I declare that nothing can shake me, nothing can move me, nothing can topple me, nothing can overthrow me because I am rooted and grounded in the love of Christ.

And my life is anchored in the eternal purposes of God. I command every spirit of fear, torment, anxiety, panic, dread, and terror to be cast out of my life in the name of Jesus. I decree that God has not given me the spirit of fear, but of power, of love, and of a sound mind. I declare that perfect love casts out fear, that I am loved with an everlasting love, that I am accepted in the beloved, that I am complete in Christ, and therefore no fear can dominate my thoughts. No anxiety can control my emotions.

No worry can dictate my actions because I trust in the Lord with all my heart and I lean not on my own understanding. I stand in the gap for my household and I decree that every generational curse, every ancestral bondage, every familiar limitation, every inherited weakness is broken off my bloodline by the superior blood of Jesus Christ. I declare that the iniquity of my father shall not be visited upon me. The sins of my forefather shall not have dominion over my generation.

the covenants of my ancestors with darkness and null and void in my life. And I am free, liberated, delivered, and redeemed from every evil inheritance. I command every evil altar in my father's house, every satanic shrine in my mother's lineage, every demonic covenant in my family tree to be destroyed by fire, consumed by the jealousy of God, and replaced with altars of worship, covenants of blessing and legacies of righteousness.

I speak to every area of my life where the enemy has stolen from me, and I command full restoration with multiplication. I decree that what was taken shall be returned sevenfold. What was stolen shall be restored a hundfold. What was lost shall be recovered with interest. What was destroyed shall be rebuilt with glory.

I declare that the years the cankerworm has eaten, the years the locust has consumed, the years the palmer has devoured, the years the caterpillar has destroyed are being restored to me right now by the Lord of hosts. I prophesy that my wasted years are converted into wisdom. My painful seasons are transformed into testimonies. My trials are turned into triumphs. My tests are changed into testimonies. and my mess is becoming my message of God's faithfulness.

I take authority over every satanic exchange, every demonic substitution, every evil replacement that has occurred in my life where good was swapped for evil, blessing was changed to curse, favor was turned to disfavor, promotion was converted to demotion, and I command a divine reversal right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that what the enemy stole in the midnight hour is returned in broad daylight. What darkness exchanged in secret is being restored publicly.

What hell substituted through manipulation is being replaced by divine intervention. And I'm receiving back everything that belongs to me with compound interest and supernatural multiplication. I release the whirlwind of God to scatter every evil gathering convened against my destiny. Every witchcraft coven assembled against my calling, every satanic council summoned against my purpose, every demonic parliament constituted against my assignment.

I decree that their meeting places are destroyed, their gathering points are demolished, their assembly halls are consumed by fire, their consultation chambers are invaded by the glory of God, and they flee in seven different directions, never to regroup again. I declare that the council of the ungodly is brought to nothing. The devices of the wicked are made of no effect. The imaginations of evil men are frustrated. And the plans of darkness are turned into foolishness by the wisdom of God.

I command every evil clock timing my life, every satanic calendar scheduling my destiny, every demonic timetable programming my breakthrough to be shattered right now by the sovereign hand of God. I decree that I do not operate by the enemy's timing. I do not function according to hell's schedule. I do not move by darkness's program, but I operate by divine timing. I function according to heaven's calendar. I move by the appointed times and seasons of the most high God. I declare that my time has come.

My season has arrived. My moment has manifested. My hour has struck. And nothing can delay what God has determined. Nothing can postpone what heaven has decreed. Nothing can defer what the spirit has ordained for my life in this season. I speak to every mountain standing before me and I command it to be removed and cast into the sea. I decree that every obstacle of impossibility becomes a testimony of God's power. Every challenge of difficulty becomes a platform for divine intervention.

Every problem of complexity becomes an opportunity for supernatural solution. Every barrier of resistance becomes a gateway to breakthrough. I declare that no mountain is too high for me to climb. No valley is too low for me to cross. No river is too wide for me to pass through. No desert is too dry for me to traverse. Because the God who is with me makes a way where there is no way. Opens doors where there are only walls. Creates paths where there are only obstacles.

and establishes highways in the wilderness for my sake. I take authority over my tongue and I command it to speak only words that align with heaven. Words that agree with scripture, words that release life, words that prophesy blessing, words that declare victory. I decree that my mouth is anointed to speak the oracles of God. My lips are consecrated to proclaim the counsel of heaven. My voice is sanctified to release the sound of faith.

and my words carry creative power to bring into existence things that are not as though they were. I declare that I shall not speak defeat. I shall not confess failure. I shall not utter negativity. I shall not pronounce death. But I shall speak success, confess victory, utter positivity, and pronounce life because the power of life and death is in my tongue. And I choose to speak life over every situation, every circumstance, every challenge, and every impossibility in my path.

I speak to every storm in my life, and I command it to be still in the name of Jesus. I decree that peace reigns in my circumstances, calmness prevails in my situation, tranquility dominates my environment, and serenity characterizes my experience. I declare that I shall not be moved by what I see. I shall not be shaken by what I hear. I shall not be disturbed by what I feel because my trust is in the Lord and my confidence is in his unfailing word.

I take authority over every word spoken against me and I decree that they fall to the ground and die without effect. I declare that no weapon formed against me shall prosper. No tongue that rises against me in judgment shall succeed. No cause pronounced against me shall stand. No hex placed upon me shall walk. No spell cast against me shall manifest.

I command every negative prophecy, every evil prediction, every demonic forecast concerning my life to be nullified and replaced with the prophetic word of the Lord that speaks life, abundance, victory, and dominion over me. I release the angels of the Lord to go before me this day to prepare my way to make my path straight, to remove every obstacle, to clear every barrier, to open every door, and to shut every gates that needs to be closed.

I decree that divine favor is my portion, supernatural grace is my inheritance, uncommon mercy is my experience, and extraordinary blessings are my testimony. I declare that this day is blessed. This moment is anointed. This hour is appointed. And I walk in the perfect will of God with confidence, boldness, and assurance that I am kept by his mighty power through faith unto salvation. No evil shall come near me. No harm shall touch me.

No weapon shall prosper against me, and I shall dwell in safety all the days of my life because the Lord is my keeper. The Lord is my shade. The Lord is my defense. And the Lord is my glory. and the lifter of my head. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I have prayed, I have decreed, I have declared, and I have established these words in the heavenlies and upon the earth, and it is settled forever. Amen.
